projecthero.guide.iron_man.glasses.body: Craft the Stark Glasses (two gold ingots over red stained glass pane, Basic Circuit, red stained glass pane), press Shift + N to open the Stark Gear screen and put them in the Eyes slot -- or just right-click them. They have their own slot, so they stay on under a suit (hidden while an Iron Man helmet is on). Wearing them you have night vision, you can call your suits -- off your Suit Platforms from the Sneak + C picker, the double-tap quick call, the Mark 7 orbital drop, Remote Pilot from a platform and /ironman suit -- and Protocol Phoenix is armed. Without them, C still puts on a suit you are carrying, the Mark 5 suitcase still opens and you can still send suits home. The glasses drop when you die, like the rest of your inventory (kept with keepInventory).
projecthero.guide.iron_man.phoenix.body: If you would die while not in a full suit, Protocol Phoenix stops the death, holds you still and calls in your best Mark 7 or later suit (from your pack or a Suit Platform, even far away). Once it is on you are back on 5 hearts and the suit pays 20% energy and 10% integrity. It only works with your Stark Glasses on, only ever brings a Mark 7 or later, needs that suit at 25%+ energy and 10%+ integrity, and recharges for 20 minutes. With no such suit you die normally.
projecthero.guide.iron_man.controls: Wearing a suit the six ability keys are R / G / X / Z / V / C; every mark has its own kit (see the Mark pages below, or press I for the spec sheet). Double-tap jump in the air to fly (except the Mark 1, which flies only with its Flight Burst). Unarmoured, C puts on any armour you are carrying straight away, and Sneak + C opens the Call Armour picker -- it lists every suit on your Suit Platforms (even ones in unloaded chunks or far away) and in your inventory, shows the hovered suit's stats side by side with your current one, can send a suit home to its platform for repairs, and has a PILOT button for flying a suit remotely. Calling a suit in needs your Stark Glasses on (Shift + N, see Stark Glasses & Stark Gear). The Mark 5 never answers C: it lives in its suitcase. Iron Man armour makes you immune to fall damage, and flying hard into the ground slams down for 20 damage, knocking everything nearby away.
